resources.string: These features are unfinished. Turning one on can change how LogDate works, and it can stop working in any update.
Reminders wait while you walk, ride or travel, and the end of one can be your reminder. Uses physical activity on this phone and your watch; it stays on your devices.
Activity awareness needs it to tell when you walk, ride or travel.

Account gets a Recovery key page where you can add a key from your recovery phrase that ranks above the server's key for your identity. It appears only when that server supports it and this device can confirm with a passkey.
The new watch app and its phone screens, on this phone and your watch.
